title: Greek-Style Seared Beef Rice Bowls
description: Thin-sliced chuck seared hard with oregano and paprika, over lemon rice from the Thermomix basket, with a Greek salad and garlic yoghurt.

steps.text: Firm the chuck ({{beef}}) in the freezer for 15–20 minutes. Optional, but it makes thin slicing much easier.
Deseed and dice the tomatoes ({{tomatoes}}), toss with a pinch of salt and leave to drain in a sieve for 10 minutes. This stops the salad flooding the rice.
Look at the grain before cutting; chuck often changes direction partway through. Cut into two or three sections along those lines, then slice each thinly against its own grain, 3–5mm.

Toss the beef with the garlic ({{garlic}} cloves), oregano ({{oregano}}), smoked paprika ({{smoked-paprika}}), salt ({{salt}}), pepper ({{pepper}}) and about half the olive oil ({{oil*0.5}}). Leave while the rice cooks.

Rinse the rice ({{rice}}) and put it in the simmering basket. Add the stock ({{stock}}), bay leaf ({{bay}}) and a wide strip of lemon zest to the bowl. Insert the basket and cook 16 min / Varoma / Speed 4. Add 2 minutes if needed.

Combine the drained tomatoes with the cucumber ({{cucumber}}), red onion ({{onion}}), capsicum ({{capsicum}}) and olives ({{olives}}). Dress with the olive oil ({{dressing-oil}}), red wine vinegar ({{vinegar}}) and oregano ({{oregano-extra}}). Scatter the fetta ({{fetta}}) over rather than tossing it through.
Stir the yoghurt ({{yoghurt}}) with the garlic ({{garlic-extra}} clove), a squeeze of lemon and a pinch of salt. Thin with a little water to a spoonable consistency.

Get the cast iron very hot with the remaining olive oil ({{oil*0.5}}). Sear the beef in two batches, 60–90 seconds each, tossing once. Do not crowd the pan. Squeeze the remaining lemon over off the heat.
Fluff the rice into bowls. Spoon over the garlic yoghurt, then the beef and pan juices, with the salad alongside or piled on top.

notes.title: Order of work
notes.text: Get the tomatoes salting and the beef in the freezer first, then everything else fits around the rice. Sear the beef last; it goes from good to grey quickly if it sits.

notes.title: Salt
notes.text: The stock carries salt, so hold back in the rice and season at the end.

notes.title: If the beef is chewy
notes.text: Next time toss the slices with 1 tsp bicarb soda, rest 20 minutes, then rinse well and pat dry before marinating.
